overall_assessment: The W3C PROV-O representation in searchright-provenance establishes a tamper-evident, stepwise-derivable lineage model for systematic search reviews. Entities (sr:SourceReceipt, sr:Review), activities (prov:startedAtTime, prov:type), and agents (prov:type, sr:provenance) map cleanly into W3C PROV namespaces. Predecessor relationships are modeled via 'wasDerivedFrom' derivations (prov:generatedEntity, prov:usedEntity), constructed by resolving the hash chain of audit events against their previous_hash links. Input validation in validate_inputs operates strictly fail-closed: unresolved predecessors trigger ProvenanceError::UnresolvedPredecessor, cross-review receipts or events trigger ProvenanceError::ReviewMismatch, and colliding IDs or hashes trigger ProvenanceError::DuplicateIdentifier. Sorting of receipts and events prior to document generation ensures byte-level determinism regardless of input slice ordering.

findings.description: wasDerivedFrom chains strictly resolve predecessors within the provided audit event slice; long-lived multi-session reviews requiring pagination of historical audit logs must ensure full ancestor batches are supplied to avoid UnresolvedPredecessor errors.
findings.recommendation: Document slice completeness requirements in searchright-provenance API docs and living review update pipelines.

findings.description: Stepwise derivation indexing maps each audit event to its immediate prior event hash, converting linear hash chains into explicit prov:usedEntity dependencies with zero split-brain ambiguity.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the GENESIS sentinel root convention across all audit event initializers.

findings.description: Input sorting in build_prov and build_ro_crate guarantees bitwise reproducible JSON output across all permutations of input receipts and audit events.
findings.recommendation: Maintain explicit key and identifier ordering in all downstream serialization steps.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Immutable identifiers, SHA-256 event hashes, and fail-closed predecessor relationships verified by unit tests, export_edges.rs, and provenance_interop_scenarios.rs.
Review, run, receipt, audit event, and actor entities mapped into W3C PROV entity/activity/agent vocabulary.
W3C PROV entity, activity, agent, wasAssociatedWith, and wasDerivedFrom export verified; external semantic validator remains an open gate.
Bitwise deterministic reproducibility across permutations, 3-event chain derivation, and predecessor resolution verified.

calibration_notes: PROV lineage architects confirm that W3C PROV vocabulary mapping, hash-chain predecessor derivation, and fail-closed validation are completely implemented and verified by 20 Rust tests.
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only. W3C PROV-compatible JSON serialization, entity-activity-agent mappings, and fail-closed predecessor checks are verified; external W3C PROV-O ontology validation and institutional PIDs remain open gates.
